methodology.timing: Node performance.now surrounds one exported MoonBit operation; no JSON or report serialization inside timing.
methodology.session: One opaque fixture with one persistent Session per isolated worker; repeated previews and updates reuse that cache. Valid updates alternate old/new values.
methodology.optimizations: Session candidate construction hashes removals/additions, derives actual changes from supplied deltas and existing graph indexes, and indexes changed Objects/Subjects/Outgoing reads. Preview does not populate a next cache: reused results are still deep-copied, while newly evaluated isolated results are returned directly. Apply, Session initialization, and report retain their cache/result-isolation behavior. Candidate graph reconstruction, target enumeration, and dependency checks remain inside timed operations.
methodology.cold: Fresh parsing and compilation rebuild objects each call; VM/JIT is warmed. OS file I/O, process start, module import and data generation are excluded.
methodology.fairness: Full validation on a prebuilt candidate excludes graph construction. The original rebuildAndValidateInvalidFull comparator is retained unchanged: linear removals.contains filtering, public Graph API construction, and full validation. The primary comparator rebuildAndValidateInvalidFullHashed replaces only that removal lookup with a fresh Map<Triple,Bool>, charging its construction inside the timing. Both use the same public Graph API and defensive triples() copy, reconstruct all indexes and run full validation. Before/after checks require both candidate triple sequences and full recursive reports to match. Cached preview additionally tracks changes and dependencies.
methodology.memory: Bytes from process.memoryUsage snapshots. baseline/fixture/final snapshots follow explicit GC; operation snapshots bracket whole sample batches. No intra-operation peak or allocation-rate measurement. Fixture includes Turtle strings, two graphs, shapes, plan, session/cache and deltas; its delta is not cache-only overhead.
methodology.gc: Explicit GC before sample batches, never inside timed calls; naturally occurring GC remains in sample durations.
methodology.scope: Synthetic Person/company sequence-path workload, not a production dataset, cross-engine ranking or general throughput claim.

historicalComparison.limitation: Archived before and current after are separate runs, not randomized paired measurements. Comparison is cache-preview latency against its own prior implementation; the new hashed full baseline did not exist in the archived run and must not be substituted into old ratios.
